SELECT
  t.row_id,
  t.account_id,
  t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN day_of_week(from_unixtime(t.event_time / 1000, 'UTC')) IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.account_id
    ORDER BY t.event_time
    RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS amount_7d
FROM transactions_raw56bbbb_1 t
JOIN fx_rates56bbbb_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
ORDER BY t.row_id

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabb12ef4_featurestore "
WITH w AS (
  SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time, amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win
  FROM transactions_raw56bbbb_1
),
sj AS (
  SELECT a.row_id, SUM(b.amount) AS sj_sum
  FROM transactions_raw56bbbb_1 a
  JOIN transactions_raw56bbbb_1 b
    ON a.account_id = b.account_id
   AND b.event_time BETWEEN a.event_time - 604800000 AND a.event_time
  GROUP BY a.row_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS mismatches
FROM w JOIN sj ON w.row_id = sj.row_id
WHERE abs(w.win - sj.sj_sum) > 0.0001
" --json 2>/dev/null
tool_input.description: Cross-check window vs self-join for amount_7d
